feedback.worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t=\pi $ into our function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}g(\pi ) & =[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{\pi +8} \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡(\pi +1) \\ 2\operatorname{sin}⁡(\pi )\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{\pi +8} \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡(\pi +1) \\ 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
